title: Chapter 758
paragraphs: Chapter 758
Episode 186. The Overlapping Celebrations of Bamel Alliance and Minche Blacksmith Association (1)
The group was taken aback by the unexpected extreme humility of Anvil.
He even prostrated himself, not to mention kneeling down.
Upon closer inspection, tears were falling to the floor.
At least Anvil was keeping his dignity as a leader, deeply moved.
Because the association members lying next to him were sobbing.
'Crazy... It's great that things are going even better than expected, but is there no need for even the minimal confirmation?'
'These arrogant guys, just hearing the name Picon Minche, they do this? Crying?'
From this time, every grain of sand on this island belongs to Picon Minche...
Jin mulled over that phrase, suppressing his absurd feelings.
If there really was more steel in the Blacksmith's Island than the Bamel Alliance had, there should have been no reason to lament over Kinzelo.
[You'll give it all?]
"Of course!"
[Are you sure that's okay?]
"Lord Picon, our Minche Association is composed only of those who are prepared to sincerely follow Lord Picon's will. Your words from a thousand years ago are still engraved hotly in our hearts."
What did I say?
In fact, Picon wanted to ask that, but he coughed and waited for Anvil's next words.
"Don't leave the forge. Dedicate yourself only to forging weapons. Until the owner appears."
That was what Picon often told his disciples a thousand years ago.
Of course, the 'owner' Picon spoke of did not mean himself.

At that time, Picon saw his less talented disciples becoming despondent, so he told them somewhere in the world there's someone who would appreciate your weapon the most, so don't give up and put your all into it. That often resulted in masterpieces.
About fifty years after Picon's death, his intention was accurately conveyed to the later generations.
However, as time passed, the original words of Picon gradually distorted, and Anvil, who didn't know the behind-the-scenes, interpreted Picon's words like this.

"Our association has been eagerly waiting for the appearance of such an owner who can be called the reincarnation of Lord Picon, who can advance the blacksmiths of this world to the next level. That's why the association has maintained a three-person management system without appointing a 'Iron King' for the past thousand years."
What is this Iron King...?
Picon suppressed that question and put on a natural-looking smile. Yes, you have kept my will well, with that expression on his face.
There was no such position as "Iron King" when Picon was alive.
The words symbolizing Picon were the legendary blacksmith after all.
Anyway, according to Anvil, the known leaders of the association, Fire, Anvil, and Hammer, were all temporary.
They were all waiting for a blacksmith worthy of being recognized as Picon's successor, and the true leader's position, the Iron King, was always vacant.
In the meantime, it was not Picon's successor, but Picon Minche himself, who visited the association as the God of the Blacksmith, hence the strong reaction.
From the association's point of view, the Iron King they had been waiting for a thousand years had finally returned.
[Hmm... Excellent.]
Soon after Picon spoke in a solemn voice, Anvil and the association members raised their heads.
Their moist eyes were shining like they had received salvation.
Then, Anvil was startled again by himself.
"Ah! I wonder... I was so happy that I may have spoken out of turn. Lord Picon, if you feel uncomfortable accepting the assets of our blacksmiths..."
Jin quickly jabbed Picon in the ribs.
[That's not the case. From today, I will lead you again.]
Though he said it thoughtlessly, the effect was perfect.
"This is the greatest honor of my life! We will escort you inside quickly!"
Before moving, the association members took out small horns from their possessions and blew them. The horn was to announce that the official document of the Bamel Alliance was true.
As soon as the horn sounded, the once dark island lit up immediately.
Flames were rising everywhere in the forge, which occupied 80% of the total area of the island.
The association members waiting at the forge hurriedly moved to prepare to welcome Picon.
Also, Anvil's attitude towards Jin changed.
"Please forgive the rudeness earlier, Honored Guest. You really brought Lord Picon, from now on, you're our benefactor."
"Thank you for saying so."
What about me? Sirius wanted to argue, but he held his temper. He was so taken aback that he could hardly speak.
All the blacksmiths of the association were prostrating themselves in line at the entrance of the forge.
'They're really fanatics.'
Although it felt a bit excessive, Jin smiled at the feeling of having gained a reliable ally.
Just like when they met Anvil, a sea of tears opened for a while, and Picon encouraged the executives who introduced themselves one by one.
No one doubted Picon.
There was a reason why the appearances matched perfectly, but Picon showed a glimpse of recognizing the usage and completeness of the equipment and weapons in the forge in an instant.
With just a few conversations exchanged during the process, the blacksmiths recognized Picon's depth of knowledge and were amazed.
[Fire, why did you choose this island as the holy place for the blacksmiths? It's not even my hometown.]
Once the various rituals and greetings were over, Picon began asking formal questions in Jin's stead.
"Can I answer in the absence of the Lord of the Bifrost?"
[I will personally guarantee the Lord of the Bifrost. And in the future, I would like you to pay respect to the Lord of the Bifrost as well. He is my guest.]
"We will do as you say."
If Syron, Talalris, or Rond had seen this scene, they would have been speechless in disbelief.
Sirius swallowed a sigh as he bowed his head.
"The reason we established our headquarters here is because of the Sea Steel."
[Sea Steel?]

"It means the steel that comes from the sea. The association's headquarters has been on this island for about three hundred years. We chose it as the headquarters because there is no other place where Sea Steel is more abundant."
[I am aware of the existence of Sea Steel, but wouldn't it be extremely difficult to collect? I heard that the association has more steel than the empire or any other large force.]
"That is half right and half wrong."
[Explain.]
Even though it was a moment to reveal the biggest secret of the association, the executives, including Fire, did not hesitate.

"First of all, we collect Sea Steel through a monster that has the ocean as its main habitat. It's a monster called Bailam, a friend that our previous executives captured. Although it's a monster, it has a distinct ego and has no intention or reason to harm humans."
"There's a monster like that?"
The executives nodded at Jin's question.
[Yes, Honored Guest. Its main diet is marine life and seaweed. Since it mostly resides in the deep sea, it's not usually seen by people.]
Then it was a beneficial entity, closer to a spirit than a monster.

"A long time ago, Bailam made a deal with us. Originally, Bailam had a habit of grinding sea steel at the bottom of the sea to sharpen its teeth, but at some point, it reached a limit with unprocessed sea steel."
"So, you're saying that when you brought Sea Steel, you processed a part of it to make a lump of steel for Bailam to grind its teeth?"
"That's correct."
The Sea Steel buried in the waters near the blacksmith's island is close to infinite.

Usually, the cost of mining and processing was much greater than the value of Sea Steel, so no one was interested in it, but the association had been obtaining Sea Steel almost for free for hundreds of years through Bailam.
The association was the only group that could process such a large amount of Sea Steel quickly.
It was a novel idea that monsters and humans could live in this kind of symbiotic relationship.
"It's a fascinating story. I wonder how you managed to keep this a secret till now."
The executives led the party underground in the forge.
There was a huge hatch in the center, and when the executives pulled the lever, the floor split open to reveal the sea. It was a space big enough to hold several ships.
With such a space, there was no way for the spectacle of Bailam supplying the association with steel to be exposed to the outside.

"Thanks to this background and the mindset that you, Picon, have passed on, our association has never had to complain about anything. Until recently, it would not be an exaggeration to say that the association had the most steel in the world."
The group stared at the swaying sea and gasped.
Jin also admired it, but he could feel a strong spirit coming up from the sea.
"It seems that Bailam has been tainted by chaos."
At his words, the executives frowned as if they were heartbroken.

"... Yes. The relationship between Bailam and the association is not merely symbiotic, we are now more like friends. The chaos that has spread in the world due to the succession of the Imperial Palace and the Ominous Palace has made Bailam ill."
When Fire blew a horn a few times towards the sea, the sea surface rippled and foam rose.
A moment later, the surfaced Bailam had a shape very similar to a giant whale.
[Peee...]
Its cry was also similar to that of a whale, and it did not look threatening at all, just like the executives had said, with its overall rounded shape.
However, there were black spots of chaos all over its body.
Bailam kept crying out as if in pain.
"If Bailam does not recover as it is, not only will we be unable to mine Sea Steel, but all the members of the association will fall into sorrow at the loss of a friend."
While there was joy in Picon's arrival, there was also the sadness of potentially having to say goodbye to a friend.
Picon seemed to be choosing his words for a moment, and Sirius couldn't hide his pained expression at the sight of Bailam's adorable but sickly appearance.
And then Jin, looking closely at Bailam, said this.
"Fire, has there been any physical change in Bailam?"
"What do you mean?"
"I mean, excluding the black spots, does Bailam look exactly the same as before it was tainted by chaos?"
"Yes, it does."
Jin gave a sly smile.
"I think I might be able to cure that friend."
